Polynomial Protocol's Zap contract on Optimism was exploited on November 18, 2022, allowing an attacker to drain USDC from users who had approved the contract. The vulnerability arose from lack of input validation, leading to an unauthorized call that spent victim allowances. The swapAndDeposit function allowed arbitrary values for parameters swapTarget and swapData, enabling attackers to call transferFrom on the USDC token and drain pre-approved allowances from victims without access control or selector validation.
